description: A plan to bring activity back to a commercial district: market reality, physical conditions, the people already invested there, and a sequence of actions with named partners.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the kickoff date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.
Revitalization plans fail on implementation rather than analysis. The action plan is a separate deliverable for that reason, and every action in it should name a partner who has agreed to it.
The market assessment must be allowed to say the district cannot support what people hope for. A plan built on a market conclusion nobody tested is the most expensive kind of optimism.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Market and economic assessment
deliverables.summary: What the district can realistically support, by use and over what period, with the data behind it.

deliverables.title: Physical conditions assessment
deliverables.summary: Buildings, storefronts, public realm, parking, access and vacancy, surveyed rather than estimated.

deliverables.title: Business and resident input summary
deliverables.summary: What the people already invested in the district say they need.

deliverables.title: Revitalization strategy framework
deliverables.summary: Catalyst sites, public realm improvements, programs and policy changes, organized into a strategy.

deliverables.title: Draft revitalization plan
deliverables.summary: The complete draft assembled for review.

deliverables.title: Action plan with partners and sequence
deliverables.summary: Each action with its partner, its funding pathway and its place in the sequence.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: Scope, district boundary and partners confirmed.

milestones.title: Merchant and property owner walkabout
milestones.summary: The district walked with the people who operate in it.

milestones.title: Community visioning session
milestones.summary: The wider community describes what the district should become.

milestones.title: Open house on the draft plan
milestones.summary: The draft and its action list shown publicly.

milestones.title: Adoption of the plan
milestones.summary: Adoption by the governing body or the sponsoring organization.
